Author-directed development; proposed chronology and counts · 2026-11-06
Explore the interactive shelter atlas

Origin and setting
An experimental workspace retained fragments whose checking routines had been damaged.

Human system: Lattice · experimental workspace recovery. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Local process
Partial Weave assembles available functions when complete configurations are absent; its incomplete checks permit volatile combinations.
Proposed local course
The proposed local history includes unstable reconstruction and eventual loss of community continuity. Custodian intervention and internal faults remain competing or combined causes.
Unresolved interpretations
The end of the community does not demonstrate that every attempted combination was a person or that none was.
Atlas placement

Origin step -2. 0: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 1: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 2: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 3: fragmented (4 associated systems lost); 4: fragmented (5 associated systems lost); 5: fragmented (6 associated systems lost); 6: destroyed (15 associated systems lost); 7: destroyed (15 associated systems lost). These placements elaborate the current hypothetical map; they are not independently verified casualties. A functioning haven can lose continuity among particular arrivals without changing its community census status.
